title: Wick's Back Door
summary: Wick kept his word. He writes that a Gold-Sworn wagon train is resting at a pillager outpost with stolen grain and two captives. He's left a gap in the palisade for you.

goals.say: The captives run for the trees. One of them shouts Wick's name as a thank-you.

quest_book.title: Wick's Back Door
quest_book.author: Wick
pages:
You let me go. Most wouldn't have.

There's a wagon train at the outpost east of you. Grain they took, and two of yours in the cart.

I loosened a stake on the north side. Go at night.

We're square now. Mostly.

- W.
